mix: a budget road trip from Islamabad, Skardu-based operators' own tours, flight-based blossom and autumn trips, and long routes that cross Deosai into Astore or Hunza

day_groups.label: 7-9 days
day_groups.why: Enough for Skardu's lakes, Shigar, Khaplu and a Deosai day - fly at least one way or you lose two days on the road each way.

day_groups.label: 10-11 days
day_groups.why: Adds Hushe or Machulo in the Ghanche valleys, or a proper hike like Marsur Rock.

day_groups.label: 15 days or more
day_groups.why: Grand loops that cross Deosai to Astore and Rama Lake, then carry on to Hunza.

days_tip: Skardu flights use jets (Gilgit's use small turboprops), but they're still weather-dependent - keep a buffer day, and know the road plan B before you go.
footer_html: Planning a honeymoon? Couples' packages are compared on my Skardu honeymoon packages page.
notes: Deosai is only open from about mid-June to late September or early October; any trip that crosses it is summer-only. UK travel advice (FCDO) warns against all travel on the KKH between Mansehra and Chilas - trips that fly, or use the Babusar road (open roughly late May to October), avoid it.

packages.name: 8-Day Skardu, Deosai, Shigar & Khaplu Trip
packages.best: Cheapest way to see all of Skardu's highlights
itinerary: Pre-dawn start from Islamabad; breakfast in Balakot, through Naran and over Babusar to Chilas.
Chilas to Skardu, stopping where three mountain ranges meet.
Katpana Lake, Shangrila Resort and Upper Kachura Lake.
The cold desert and Shigar Fort.
Khaplu: the palace-fort, Chaqchan Mosque and bazaar, then Manthokha waterfall.
Deosai National Park via Satpara Lake, with stops at Bara Pani and Kala Pani.
Skardu back down to Chilas.
Chilas to Islamabad, and on to Lahore near midnight.
good: Lowest published price, with all meals listed
Covers Shigar, Khaplu and Deosai in one trip
watch: The Babusar route only runs from about late May to October
Three of eight days are mostly driving
"From" price - ask what's included and how many share the vehicle

packages.name: Skardu Cherry Blossom Tour
packages.best: The shortest Skardu trip, timed for blossom
itinerary: Arrive in Islamabad and transfer to your hotel.
Fly to Skardu and explore the town.
Through Shigar's heritage villages on the way to Khaplu.
Khaplu up to Hushe for cherry and apricot blossom.
Back to Skardu via Satpara Lake, the sacred rock carvings and the bazaar.
Fly to Islamabad; sunset in the Margalla Hills.
Taxila, then departure.
good: Flights both ways keep it to a week
Includes Hushe, which most short trips skip
watch: Two flight days - ask what happens if a flight is cancelled
No price on the page

packages.name: Skardu Tour (starts in Skardu)
packages.travel: Starts and ends at Skardu airport
packages.best: Lesser-known Baltistan with a Skardu-based team
itinerary: Arrive at Skardu airport; Upper Kachura Lake and Chunda Valley.
Katpana cold desert and lake, and the Buddha rock carvings.
Shigar: Sarfaranga cold desert, Blind Lake and Shigar Fort.
To Khaplu, stopping at Chocolate Rock where the Indus and Shyok meet.
Morning hike to the Thoksi Khar viewpoint, then on to Machulo village.
A short guided walk on the Thagus "death track", then back to Skardu.
Basho Valley's forests and meadows.
Hike from Hussaini village up to Marsur Rock (about 2-2.5 hours).
Transfer to Skardu airport.
good: All nine days are spent in Baltistan - no days lost in Islamabad
Machulo, Basho and Thagus are rarely in packages
watch: Getting to and from Skardu isn't part of the day plan - ask if it's included
Two hiking days; check they suit your fitness
No price published

packages.name: Skardu Valley Tour
packages.best: Active travellers who want a real hike
itinerary: Arrive in Islamabad and transfer to your hotel.
Fly to Skardu; Buddha Rock and Kharpocho Fort.
Shigar: a walk to Blind Lake, Shigar Fort and Sarfaranga cold desert.
A full day out to Manthokha (or Khamosh) waterfall.
Khaplu: Chaqchan Mosque, Masherbrum views and a trout lunch at Saling.
Back to Skardu, then a long hike (about 8 hours) up to Marsur Rock.
Day trip to Deosai National Park.
Shangrila, Upper Kachura Lake and Choq Valley.
Fly back to Islamabad.
Departure.
good: Covers both Deosai and a proper hike
watch: Flights both ways - keep a buffer day
The Marsur Rock day is long and high; ask about pace and fitness
No price published

packages.name: Baltistan Autumn Tour
packages.travel: Fly, with a road plan B built in
packages.best: Autumn colours with a clear flight plan B
itinerary: Arrive in Islamabad and transfer to your hotel.
Fly to Skardu - or, if the flight fails, drive to Chilas.
Skardu sightseeing - or drive on from Chilas to Skardu.
Buddha Rock, Shangrila and Upper Kachura Lake.
Drive to Shigar Valley.
Shigar to Khaplu via Ghowari.
Through Haldi and Kanday to Hushe.
Hushe back via Khaplu and Kharmang to Skardu.
Fly to Islamabad - or drive to Chilas.
Islamabad sightseeing - or drive on to Islamabad.
Departure.

Includes Hushe and the Kharmang road
watch: Priced in US dollars for foreign visitors - ask about a local rate

packages.name: Deosai Plateau Tour (camping)
packages.travel: Fly in, drive out via Astore
itinerary: Islamabad hotel.
Fly to Skardu.
Skardu to Khaplu via Shigar.
Khaplu up to the Deosai plateau (camp).
A day on Deosai, camping near Small Deosai.
Down through Astore to Chilas.
Chilas back to Islamabad.

watch: Summer only (Deosai opens about mid-June)
Nights at around 4,000m are cold - check the tents and sleeping bags
No price or meals published

packages.name: Skardu, Deosai, Rama Lake & Fairy Meadows Tour
packages.best: The full loop: Astore, Deosai, Skardu, Hunza and Fairy Meadows
itinerary: Arrive in Islamabad.
Over Babusar Pass to Chilas, with lunch in Naran.
Chilas up to Rama Meadows near Astore.
Across the Deosai plateau to Khaplu.
Day trip from Khaplu to Machulo valley.
Khaplu to Shigar.
Shigar to Skardu.
Skardu to Karimabad, Hunza.
Baltit Fort, Hopper and Attabad Lake, then on to Gulmit.
Passu, Borith Lake and the suspension bridges.
Full-day trip to Khunjerab Pass.
Gulmit to Gilgit via the Rakaposhi viewpoint.
Jeep from Raikot Bridge and hike up to Fairy Meadows.
Back down and on to Besham.
Taxila and Islamabad.
good: Enters Baltistan across Deosai - a spectacular way in
Skardu, Hunza and Fairy Meadows in one trip, full board
watch: Summer only - it needs both Babusar and Deosai open (about mid-June to September)
Fifteen days, mostly on the move
No price published

packages.name: Deosai Plateau Tour (Deosai, Astore and Hunza)

Up past Satpara Lake onto Deosai.
A day on Deosai, including Sheosar Lake.

Rama Lake to Astore.
